text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Interior Minister Driss Basri tells Paris Mediterranean conference of need to ease visa procedures for Moroccans on medical, educational or tourist trips.
- Germany's Commerzbank stake increase in Banque Marocaine du Commerce Exterieur is a major step in both countries cooperation.
- Morocco voices concern about conditions to get French visa.
- Interior Minister Driss Basri says legislative elections will be held in September.
- Some 150 Palestinians, who will be in charge of manning Gaza airport, arrived in Morocco for training.
- Socialist party Union Socialiste des Forces Populaires (USFP) says women's participation will be up 20 percent in next elections.
